<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>BIT 美股开户礼｜30天加速器会员 + $310 新用户福利</title>
<meta name="description" content="完成 BIT 证券美股账户开户（KYC），免费领 30 天加速器会员，再享 $310 新用户开户福利。身份证一键开户，USDT/USDC 稳定币入金。">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter+Tight:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@500&family=Noto+Sans+SC:wght@400;500;700&display=swap">
<style>
/* ============================================================
   Coinbase editorial v4 — 灰白交替色带 · 无边框圆角卡 · 小胶囊 CTA
   Canvas #fff · Band #f7f7f7 · Dark hero #0a0b0d · Blue #0052ff
   Inter Tight 500 −0.02em display · Noto Sans SC · JetBrains Mono nums
   ============================================================ */
:root{
  --blue:#0052ff; --blue-d:#4a80ff;
  --ink:#0a0b0d; --body:#5b616e; --muted:#7c828a;
  --hl:#dee1e6; --hl-soft:#eef0f3; --canvas:#fff; --soft:#f7f7f7;
  --dark:#0a0b0d; --ond:#fff; --ond-soft:#a8acb3;
  --hl-dark-soft:rgba(255,255,255,.09);
}
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
  background:var(--canvas);color:var(--body);
  font-family:'Noto Sans SC',-apple-system,'PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;
  font-size:15px;line-height:1.72;padding-bottom:82px;overflow-x:hidden;
}
.wrap{max-width:620px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
a{color:var(--blue);text-decoration:none}
h2{font-family:'Inter Tight','Noto Sans SC',sans-serif;font-size:25px;line-height:1.32;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-0.02em;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:8px;text-wrap:balance}
.sec{padding:44px 0}
.sec-tag{display:block;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:12px;background:none;border:none;padding:0}
.sec-sub{color:var(--body);font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:16px}

/* 灰白交替色带（Coinbase 分区节奏） */
.band-soft{background:var(--soft)}
.band-white{background:var(--canvas)}

/* ---------- 暗色 hero：信息紧凑 ---------- */
.hero{background:var(--dark);color:var(--ond-soft);padding:64px 0 24px}
.copartner{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ond-soft);margin-bottom:14px}
.copartner b{color:var(--ond);font-weight:500}
.copartner .dot{width:3px;height:3px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ond-soft);opacity:.6}
.gift-card{background:none;border:none;border-radius:0;padding:0;margin-bottom:10px;box-shadow:none}
.gift-card h1{font-family:'Inter Tight','Noto Sans SC',sans-serif;font-size:26px;line-height:1.4;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-0.02em;color:var(--ond);text-wrap:balance}
.gift-card h1 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--blue-d)}
.gift-card .note{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ond-soft);margin-top:9px}


/* ---------- 首屏 TG 群抽奖卡 ---------- */
.tgline{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
  border-radius:18px;padding:12px 14px;margin-top:16px;
}
.tg-qr{flex:none;width:76px;background:#fff;padding:5px;border-radius:10px;display:block}
.tg-qr img{width:100%;display:block;border-radius:6px}
.tg-txt{min-width:0;display:block}
.tg-t{display:block;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;line-height:1.45}
.tg-s{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--ond-soft);line-height:1.55;margin-top:3px}
.tg-go{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--blue-d);margin-top:5px}

/* ---------- BIT 证券：紧跟按钮 ---------- */
.intro{padding-top:18px}
.whatis h2{font-size:25px}
.adv{list-style:none;margin:10px 0 0;border-top:1px solid var(--hl)}
.adv li{
  display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;
  background:none;border:none;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hl-soft);
  border-radius:0;padding:14px 2px;margin-bottom:0;font-size:15px;color:var(--muted);
}
.adv li .ic{flex:none;width:auto;height:auto;border-radius:0;background:none;color:var(--blue);font-size:14px;font-weight:700;margin-top:2px;display:block}
.adv li b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:500;font-size:15.5px}

/* ---------- 信任区：灰色圆角块，标题加大 ---------- */
.trust{
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  background:linear-gradient(150deg,#EEF3FF 0%,#F8FAFF 52%,#E9F1FF 100%);
  border:1px solid rgba(0,82,255,.14);border-radius:28px;padding:26px 22px;margin:34px 0 44px;
}
.trust::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-50% -20% auto -20%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(50% 60% at 20% 0%,rgba(0,82,255,.12),transparent 70%)}
.trust>*{position:relative}
.trust .lic{border-top-color:rgba(0,82,255,.14)}
.trust .t-title{font-family:'Inter Tight','Noto Sans SC',sans-serif;font-size:20px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-0.02em;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:20px;display:block}
.trust-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px 16px;margin-bottom:20px}
.trust-grid .tg-item{background:none;border:none;border-radius:0;padding:0}
.trust-grid .tg-num{font-family:'Inter Tight',sans-serif;font-size:25px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.035em;color:var(--ink);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;line-height:1.1}
.trust-grid .tg-num .s{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:var(--blue);margin-left:2px}
.trust-grid .tg-lab{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px;line-height:1.55}
.trust .lic{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--body);line-height:1.9;border-top:1px solid var(--hl);padding-top:15px}
.trust .lic b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:500}

/* ---------- 卡片：无边框圆角，随色带反转 ---------- */
.card{background:var(--canvas);border:none;border-radius:20px;padding:20px;margin-bottom:12px}
.band-white .card{background:var(--soft)}
.steps{counter-reset:s;list-style:none}
.steps li{display:flex;gap:14px;padding:11px 0;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--body)}
.steps li::before{
  counter-increment:s;content:counter(s);
  flex:none;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--soft);color:var(--ink);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-family:'Inter Tight',sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;margin-top:2px;
}
.band-soft .steps li::before{background:var(--soft)}
.rule{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.8;margin-top:8px;list-style:none}
.rule li{margin-left:0}
.rule li::before{content:"·　"}

/* 四重福利：软底圆角卡内细线行 */
.benefit4{display:block;background:var(--soft);border-radius:20px;padding:6px 18px}
.band-soft .benefit4{background:var(--canvas)}
.benefit4 .b-item{
  background:none;border:none;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hl-soft);border-radius:0;
  padding:13px 0;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;align-items:baseline;
}
.benefit4 .b-item:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.benefit4 .b-item .b-t{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:500;margin-bottom:0;color:var(--ink);flex:none}
.benefit4 .b-item .b-d{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.6;text-align:right}

/* 奖励两条并入福利列表 */
.benefit4 details{background:none !important;border-radius:0;margin:0;border-top:1px solid var(--hl-soft)}
.benefit4 details summary{padding:13px 0;font-size:14.5px}
.benefit4 details .d-body{padding:0 0 15px;font-size:13px}
.benefit4 .b-item:last-of-type{border-bottom:none}

/* why：白卡叠在灰带上 */
.why{background:var(--canvas);border:none;border-radius:20px;padding:18px 20px;margin-bottom:10px}
.why .w-t{font-family:'Inter Tight','Noto Sans SC',sans-serif;font-size:16.5px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-0.01em;margin-bottom:3px;color:var(--ink)}
.why p{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted)}

/* 手风琴：圆角卡（随色带反转） */
details{background:var(--soft);border:none;border-radius:16px;margin-bottom:10px;overflow:hidden}
.band-soft details{background:var(--canvas)}
summary{padding:15px 18px;font-size:14.5px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;list-style:none;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:14px;color:var(--ink)}
summary::after{content:"＋";color:var(--muted);font-weight:300;font-size:17px;flex:none}
details[open] summary::after{content:"－"}
details .d-body{padding:0 18px 17px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--body);line-height:1.85}
details .d-body b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:500}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13px;margin:12px 0;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
th,td{border:none;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hl-soft);padding:9px 4px;text-align:center;color:var(--body)}
th{background:none;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500;font-size:11.5px}
td b{color:var(--ink);font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-weight:500}

/* 联系 */
.contact{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
.contact .c-item{background:var(--soft);border:none;border-radius:24px;padding:20px 16px;text-align:center}
.contact img{width:100%;max-width:130px;border-radius:14px;background:#fff}
.contact .c-n{font-size:12.5px;margin-top:10px;color:var(--muted)}
.contact .c-n b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:500}

.foot{border-top:1px solid var(--hl);padding:24px 0 16px;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.85;margin:0 auto;max-width:620px;padding-left:20px;padding-right:20px}
.foot p{margin-bottom:8px}
@media(min-width:480px){.gift-card h1{font-size:33px}}

/* ============ Web 端适配（≥900px，Coinbase 桌面节奏） ============ */
@media(min-width:900px){
  .wrap{max-width:1120px;padding:0 48px}
  body{padding-bottom:0;font-size:16px}
  .sticky-cta{display:none !important}
  .float-card{display:block}
  .totop{display:flex}

  /* hero：左标题右转化 */
  .hero{padding:120px 0 72px}
  .copartner{margin-bottom:40px;font-size:14px}
  .hero .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 400px;column-gap:80px;align-items:start}
  .copartner{grid-column:1/-1}
  .gift-card{grid-column:1;grid-row:2;align-self:center;margin-bottom:0}
  .gift-card h1{font-size:52px;line-height:1.3}
  .gift-card .note{font-size:14px;margin-top:16px}
  .hero .gifts{grid-column:2;grid-row:2;margin-bottom:18px;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:12px}
  .gift{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;padding:22px 24px 40px;border-radius:22px}
  .gift .big{font-size:48px;margin-bottom:0;flex:none}
  .gift .big .u{font-size:22px}
  .gift .txt .t{font-size:16px;margin-bottom:3px}
  .gift .txt .d{font-size:12px}
  .gift .lockline{padding:7px 22px;font-size:11.5px}
  .cta-row{grid-column:2;grid-row:3}

  /* BIT 证券：两列优势 */
  .intro{padding-top:72px}
  .whatis h2{font-size:36px}
  .adv{display:grid;grid-template-columns:0.92fr 1.08fr;gap:20px;margin-top:28px;border-top:none}
  .adv li{background:var(--soft);border-radius:24px;border-bottom:none;padding:28px 30px;font-size:16.5px;gap:14px}
  .adv li b{font-size:20px}
  .adv li .ic{font-size:17px;margin-top:3px}

  /* 信任区：四列大数字 */
  .trust{padding:44px 48px;margin:56px 0 72px;border-radius:32px}
  .trust .t-title{font-size:28px;margin-bottom:30px}
  .trust-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:28px;margin-bottom:28px}
  .trust-grid .tg-num{font-size:34px}
  .trust-grid .tg-num .s{font-size:17px}
  .trust-grid .tg-lab{font-size:12.5px}
  .trust .lic{font-size:13.5px;padding-top:20px}

  /* 通用板块 */
  .sec{padding:76px 0}
  h2{font-size:34px}
  .sec-tag{font-size:13px}
  .sec-sub{font-size:15px;margin-bottom:24px}

  /* 福利一步骤：两列排 */
  .card{padding:28px 32px;border-radius:24px}
  .steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;column-gap:56px}
  .steps li{font-size:15px}

  /* 福利二列表加宽 */
  .benefit4{padding:10px 32px;border-radius:24px}
  .benefit4 .b-item{padding:16px 0}
  .benefit4 .b-item .b-t{font-size:15.5px}
  .benefit4 .b-item .b-d{font-size:13px}
  .benefit4 details summary{padding:16px 0;font-size:15.5px}

  /* 产品优势：2×2 白卡 */
  #why{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0 20px}
  #why .sec-tag,#why h2{grid-column:1/-1}
  .why{padding:24px 28px;margin-bottom:20px;border-radius:24px}
  .why .w-t{font-size:18px}
  .why p{font-size:14px}

  /* 手风琴 / 联系 */
  summary{padding:18px 24px;font-size:16px}
  details .d-body{padding:0 24px 20px;font-size:14px}
  .contact{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,320px)}
  .contact .c-item{padding:26px}
  .contact img{max-width:150px}
  .foot{max-width:1120px;padding-left:48px;padding-right:48px;padding-top:28px}
}

/* ---------- 渐变与阴影 ---------- */
:root{
  --grad-blue:linear-gradient(135deg,#3D7BFF 0%,#0052FF 52%,#0038B8 100%);
  --grad-gold:linear-gradient(135deg,#FDEAC2 0%,#F0C888 44%,#D29C4C 100%);
  --navy2:linear-gradient(135deg,#182238 0%,#101728 58%,#0B1120 100%);
  --sh-blue:0 14px 34px -10px rgba(0,82,255,.44);
  --sh-gold:0 16px 40px -14px rgba(201,149,68,.45);
}
@keyframes shine{0%{left:-60%}55%{left:130%}100%{left:130%}}

/* ---------- 顶部固定导航 ---------- */
.topbar{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:90;padding:10px 0;transition:background .3s,border-color .3s,box-shadow .3s;border-bottom:1px solid transparent}
.topbar .inner{max-width:620px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:14px;color:#fff;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em;transition:color .3s}
.brand .mark{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--grad-blue);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:none;font-family:'Inter Tight',sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,82,255,.32)}
.brand .x{color:var(--ond-soft);font-weight:400;font-size:12px;transition:color .3s}
.topbar.solid{background:rgba(255,255,255,.88);backdrop-filter:blur(18px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px);border-bottom-color:var(--hl-soft);box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(16,24,40,.05)}
.topbar.solid .brand{color:var(--ink)}
.topbar.solid .brand .x{color:var(--muted)}
.topbar .nav-cta{margin-left:auto;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;background:var(--grad-blue);border-radius:100px;padding:9px 18px;flex:none;opacity:0;transform:translateY(-6px);pointer-events:none;transition:.32s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1);box-shadow:0 6px 18px -4px rgba(0,82,255,.42);white-space:nowrap}
.topbar.solid .nav-cta{opacity:1;transform:none;pointer-events:auto}

/* ---------- 双礼包卡 ---------- */
.gifts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin-bottom:20px}
.gift{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:18px;padding:14px 15px 36px;display:block}
.gift .big{font-family:'Inter Tight',sans-serif;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.04em;font-size:31px;line-height:1;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;margin-bottom:6px}
.gift .big .u{font-size:16px;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin-left:1px}
.gift .txt .t{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.35;margin-bottom:2px}
.gift .txt .d{font-size:10.5px;line-height:1.55}
.gift .lockline{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;padding:6px 15px;font-size:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;white-space:nowrap}
.gift-gold{background:var(--grad-gold);color:#3A2A0E;box-shadow:var(--sh-gold)}
.gift-gold .big,.gift-gold .txt .t{color:#2A1D06}
.gift-gold .txt .d{color:#6A5121}
.gift-gold .lockline{background:rgba(42,29,6,.11);color:#5C4517;font-weight:600}
.gift-gold::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-30px;top:-60px;width:170px;height:170px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.6),transparent 68%);pointer-events:none}
.gift-navy{background:var(--navy2);color:#98A0AE;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);box-shadow:0 26px 54px -18px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.gift-navy .big{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#A9C4FF,#4C7DFF);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
.gift-navy .txt .t{color:#fff}
.gift-navy .txt .d{color:#8A93A3}
.gift-navy .lockline{background:rgba(61,123,255,.18);color:#9DBCFF;font-weight:600}
.gift-navy .lockline a{color:#9DBCFF;margin-left:auto;font-weight:700}

/* ---------- 主 CTA：渐变 + 流光 ---------- */
.cta-row{display:block}
.cta-main{
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;
  width:100%;background:var(--grad-blue);color:#fff;
  font-size:17px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.01em;border-radius:100px;padding:18px 28px;
  box-shadow:var(--sh-blue),0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.16) inset;
  transition:transform .18s;
}
.cta-main:active{transform:scale(.985)}
.cta-main .arw{font-size:17px;transition:transform .25s}
.cta-main:hover .arw{transform:translateX(4px)}
.cta-main::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:-60%;width:38%;background:linear-gradient(100deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.5),transparent);transform:skewX(-18deg);animation:shine 3.4s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) infinite}
.cta-cap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;font-size:12px;color:var(--ond-soft);margin-top:12px;text-align:center}
.cta-cap .tick{color:#0FA37F;font-weight:700}

/* ---------- 吸底条（滚过首屏出现，移动端） ---------- */
.sticky-cta{
  position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:95;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.9);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px);
  border-top:1px solid var(--hl);box-shadow:0 -8px 26px -12px rgba(16,24,40,.16);
  padding:10px 16px calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
  transform:translateY(120%);transition:transform .38s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1);
}
.sticky-cta.show{transform:none}
.sticky-cta .inner{max-width:620px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.sticky-cta .sm{flex:1;min-width:0}
.sticky-cta .sm .s1{font-family:'Inter Tight','Noto Sans SC',sans-serif;font-size:19px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1.15;color:var(--ink)}
.sticky-cta .sm .s1 em{font-style:normal;color:#B07E27}
.sticky-cta .sm .s2{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.4;margin-top:1px}
.sticky-cta a.go{position:relative;overflow:hidden;flex:none;text-align:center;background:var(--grad-blue);color:#fff;font-weight:900;font-size:15.5px;border-radius:100px;padding:14px 26px;box-shadow:0 10px 24px -8px rgba(0,82,255,.55)}
.sticky-cta a.go::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:-60%;width:40%;background:linear-gradient(100deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.5),transparent);transform:skewX(-18deg);animation:shine 3.4s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) infinite}

/* ---------- 桌面右下深色浮窗 ---------- */
.float-card{
  display:none;position:fixed;right:26px;bottom:26px;z-index:95;width:238px;
  background:var(--navy2);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:22px;padding:18px 18px 16px;
  box-shadow:0 30px 64px -20px rgba(16,24,40,.5),0 8px 20px -10px rgba(16,24,40,.3);
  opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px) scale(.97);pointer-events:none;
  transition:.4s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1);
}
.float-card.show{opacity:1;transform:none;pointer-events:auto}
.float-card .fc-close{position:absolute;top:9px;right:11px;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:#8A93A3;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;line-height:20px;text-align:center;padding:0}
.float-card .fc-close:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);color:#fff}
.float-card .fc-tag{font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#EFC684;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px}
.float-card .fc-big{font-family:'Inter Tight',sans-serif;font-size:40px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.045em;line-height:1;background:var(--grad-gold);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
.float-card .fc-sub{font-size:11.5px;color:#98A0AE;line-height:1.55;margin:8px 0 14px}
.float-card .fc-b{position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:block;text-align:center;background:var(--grad-gold);color:#241903;font-size:14.5px;font-weight:900;border-radius:100px;padding:12px;box-shadow:0 10px 24px -8px rgba(201,149,68,.6)}
.float-card .fc-b::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:-60%;width:40%;background:linear-gradient(100deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.7),transparent);transform:skewX(-18deg);animation:shine 3.4s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) infinite}
.float-card .fc-n{font-size:10px;color:#7C8492;text-align:center;margin-top:9px}

/* ---------- 回到顶部（桌面） ---------- */
.totop{
  display:none;position:fixed;right:280px;bottom:26px;z-index:94;
  width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:12px;
  background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--hl);color:var(--body);box-shadow:0 6px 20px -6px rgba(16,24,40,.15);
  align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:15px;cursor:pointer;
  opacity:0;transition:.35s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1);pointer-events:none;
}
.totop.show{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
.totop:hover{color:var(--blue);border-color:rgba(0,82,255,.3)}

@media(min-width:420px){.gift .big{font-size:36px}}
@media(min-width:900px){
  .topbar .inner{max-width:1120px;padding:0 48px}
  .topbar{padding:14px 0}
  .brand{font-size:16px}
  .brand .mark{width:30px;height:30px;font-size:13px}
  .topbar .nav-cta{font-size:14px;padding:11px 22px}
  .cta-main{font-size:17px;padding:17px 28px}
  .cta-cap{font-size:12.5px}
}
@media(min-width:900px){
  .float-card{display:block}
  .totop{display:flex}
  .sticky-cta{display:none !important}
  .hero .gifts{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:12px}
  .gift{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;padding:22px 24px 40px;border-radius:22px}
  .gift .big{font-size:48px;margin-bottom:0;flex:none}
  .gift .big .u{font-size:22px}
  .gift .txt .t{font-size:16px;margin-bottom:3px}
  .gift .txt .d{font-size:12px}
  .gift .lockline{padding:7px 22px;font-size:11.5px}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .cta-main::before,.sticky-cta a.go::before,.float-card .fc-b::before{animation:none}
}

/* ================= 首屏 v12：以 5 分钟极速开户为核心 ================= */
.hero{padding:64px 0 26px}
.gift-card h1{display:none}
.h-left h1{font-family:'Inter Tight','Noto Sans SC',sans-serif;font-size:30px;line-height:1.3;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-0.02em;color:var(--ond);text-wrap:balance}
.h-left h1 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--blue-d)}
.h-left .note{font-size:13px;color:var(--ond-soft);margin-top:12px}
.perks{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:8px}
.perk{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;border-radius:100px;padding:6px 12px;line-height:1.3}
.perk-gold{background:rgba(240,200,136,.16);color:#F0C888;border:1px solid rgba(240,200,136,.35)}
.perk-blue{background:rgba(74,128,255,.14);color:#9DBCFF;border:1px solid rgba(74,128,255,.35)}

.h-right{margin-top:22px}
.cta-group{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.cta-btn{
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;
  border-radius:100px;padding:17px 22px;font-size:16.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.01em;
  transition:transform .18s;
}
.cta-btn:active{transform:scale(.985)}
.cta-btn .tag{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;border-radius:100px;padding:3px 8px;line-height:1.2}
.cta-btn .arw{font-size:17px;transition:transform .25s}
.cta-btn:hover .arw{transform:translateX(4px)}
/* 主按钮：渐变 + 流光 */
.cta-btn.is-primary{background:var(--grad-blue);color:#fff;box-shadow:var(--sh-blue),0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.16) inset}
.cta-btn.is-primary .tag{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#fff}
.cta-btn.is-primary::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:-60%;width:38%;background:linear-gradient(100deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.5),transparent);transform:skewX(-18deg);animation:shine 3.4s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) infinite}
/* 次按钮：深色描边 */
.cta-btn.is-secondary{background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22)}
.cta-btn.is-secondary .tag{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);color:var(--ond-soft)}
.cta-cap{display:block;text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:var(--ond-soft);margin-top:12px;line-height:1.5}

/* 明星股 */
.stocks{margin-top:22px}
.st-head{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-bottom:10px}
.st-t{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ond)}
.st-s{font-size:11px;color:var(--ond-soft)}
.st-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px}
.st{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:14px;padding:10px 12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1px}
.st-n{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ond);line-height:1.3}
.st-k{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--ond-soft);letter-spacing:.04em}
.st-v{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;color:#34D399;margin-top:4px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.st-note{font-size:10.5px;color:#6b7280;margin-top:8px}

/* TG 入群咨询卡（复用 tgline） */
.tgline{margin-top:18px}
.tg-qr{width:64px}
.tg-t{font-size:15px}

@media(min-width:480px){.h-left h1{font-size:34px}}
@media(min-width:900px){
  .hero{padding:118px 0 70px}
  .hero .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 420px;column-gap:72px;align-items:start}
  .copartner{grid-column:1/-1}
  .h-left{grid-column:1;grid-row:2}
  .h-left h1{font-size:50px;line-height:1.22}
  .h-left .note{font-size:14.5px;margin-top:18px}
  .perk{font-size:13px;padding:7px 14px}
  .h-right{grid-column:2;grid-row:2;margin-top:0}
  .cta-btn{padding:18px 24px;font-size:17px}
  .stocks{grid-column:1;grid-row:3;margin-top:30px;max-width:560px}
  .st-grid{gap:10px}
  .st{padding:12px 14px}
  .st-v{font-size:17px}
  .hero .tgline{grid-column:2;grid-row:3;align-self:start;margin:22px 0 0;max-width:none}
  .stocks{grid-row:3/5}
  /* 顶栏/浮窗按设备切链接 */
  .nav-m{display:none}
  .nav-d{display:inline-block}
}
@media(max-width:899px){
  .nav-d{display:none}
}
/* 按钮主次随设备切换：手机主=移动端，桌面主=Web 端 */
.cta-mobile{background:var(--grad-blue);color:#fff;box-shadow:var(--sh-blue),0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.16) inset}
.cta-mobile .tag{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#fff}
.cta-mobile::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:-60%;width:38%;background:linear-gradient(100deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.5),transparent);transform:skewX(-18deg);animation:shine 3.4s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) infinite}
.cta-web{background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22)}
.cta-web .tag{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);color:var(--ond-soft)}
@media(min-width:900px){
  .cta-web{order:-1;background:var(--grad-blue);color:#fff;border:none;box-shadow:var(--sh-blue),0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.16) inset}
  .cta-web .tag{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#fff}
  .cta-web::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:-60%;width:38%;background:linear-gradient(100deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.5),transparent);transform:skewX(-18deg);animation:shine 3.4s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) infinite}
  .cta-mobile{background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);box-shadow:none;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22)}
  .cta-mobile .tag{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);color:var(--ond-soft)}
  .cta-mobile::before{display:none}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.cta-btn::before{animation:none}}

/* ================= v13：K 线背景 · 双渐变按钮 · 大标签 ================= */

.st::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:60%;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,0),rgba(52,211,153,.06));pointer-events:none}

/* 按钮：移动端金色渐变 + 流光，Web 端蓝色渐变 + 流光，两端一致 */
.cta-btn .tag{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.04em;padding:5px 11px}
.cta-btn{font-size:17px}
.cta-mobile,.cta-mobile:hover{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#FDEAC2 0%,#F0C888 44%,#D29C4C 100%);color:#241903;
  border:none;box-shadow:0 14px 34px -10px rgba(201,149,68,.55),0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.18) inset;
}
.cta-mobile .tag{background:rgba(36,25,3,.14);color:#241903}
.cta-mobile .arw{color:#241903}
.cta-mobile::before{content:"";display:block;position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:-60%;width:38%;background:linear-gradient(100deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.7),transparent);transform:skewX(-18deg);animation:shine 3.4s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) infinite}
.cta-web{background:var(--grad-blue);color:#fff;border:none;box-shadow:var(--sh-blue),0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.16) inset}
.cta-web .tag{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#fff}
.cta-web::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:-60%;width:38%;background:linear-gradient(100deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.5),transparent);transform:skewX(-18deg);animation:shine 3.4s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) infinite}
@media(min-width:900px){
  .cta-mobile{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#FDEAC2 0%,#F0C888 44%,#D29C4C 100%);box-shadow:0 14px 34px -10px rgba(201,149,68,.55),0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.18) inset;border:none}
  .cta-mobile .tag{background:rgba(36,25,3,.14);color:#241903}
  .cta-mobile::before{display:block}
  .cta-btn .tag{font-size:14px}
  .cta-btn{font-size:17.5px}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.cta-mobile::before,.cta-web::before{animation:none}}

/* ================= v14：首屏股价全幅背景 + 行情带 ================= */
.hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.stockbg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block;pointer-events:none;z-index:0}
.hero-veil{
  position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:1;
  background:
    radial-gradient(70% 60% at 22% 40%,rgba(10,11,13,.82) 0%,rgba(10,11,13,.35) 60%,rgba(10,11,13,0) 100%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(10,11,13,.75) 0%,rgba(10,11,13,.25) 45%,rgba(10,11,13,.6) 85%,rgba(10,11,13,.92) 100%);
}
.hero>.wrap{position:relative;z-index:2}
.topbar{z-index:90}
/* 行情带 */
.ticker{position:relative;z-index:2;margin-top:22px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);background:rgba(10,11,13,.55);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);overflow:hidden}
.tk-track{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:34px;width:max-content;padding:11px 0;animation:tkmove 38s linear infinite;white-space:nowrap}
.ticker:hover .tk-track{animation-play-state:paused}
@keyframes tkmove{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
.tk-label{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--ond-soft);letter-spacing:.04em;padding-right:6px;border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
.tk{display:inline-flex;align-items:baseline;gap:7px;font-size:13px}
.tk b{color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.tk i{font-style:normal;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--ond-soft);letter-spacing:.05em}
.tk em{font-style:normal;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-weight:500;color:#34D399;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.tk-note{font-size:10.5px;color:#6b7280;padding-left:6px;border-left:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
@media(min-width:900px){
  .ticker{margin-top:56px}
  .tk-track{gap:48px;padding:13px 0}
  .tk{font-size:14px}
  .tk em{font-size:14px}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.tk-track{animation:none}}

/* ================= v15：明星股标题块 · 行情带扩容 ================= */
.st-intro{position:relative;z-index:2;margin-top:26px}
.st-h{font-family:'Inter Tight','Noto Sans SC',sans-serif;font-size:22px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-0.02em;color:var(--ond);line-height:1.3}
.st-brands{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ond);opacity:.85;margin-top:6px}
.st-line{font-size:13px;color:var(--ond-soft);margin-top:3px}
.ticker{margin-top:14px}
@media(min-width:900px){
  .hero .wrap.st-intro{margin-top:44px;display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .st-h{font-size:28px}
  .st-brands{font-size:15px;margin-top:0}
  .st-line{font-size:14px;margin-top:0;flex-basis:100%}
  .ticker{margin-top:18px}
}

/* 福利胶囊：加大 + 可点击跳详情 */
.perks{gap:10px;margin-top:12px}
.perk{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:700;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:100px;gap:6px;transition:transform .18s,background .2s,border-color .2s;cursor:pointer}
.perk .pk-arw{font-size:15px;opacity:.75;transition:transform .2s}
.perk:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}
.perk:hover .pk-arw{transform:translateX(3px)}
.perk-gold{background:rgba(240,200,136,.2);color:#F6D79A;border:1px solid rgba(240,200,136,.5)}
.perk-gold:hover{background:rgba(240,200,136,.3)}
.perk-blue{background:rgba(74,128,255,.18);color:#B4CCFF;border:1px solid rgba(74,128,255,.5)}
.perk-blue:hover{background:rgba(74,128,255,.28)}
@media(min-width:900px){.perk{font-size:15.5px;padding:11px 18px}}

/* 明星股标题块进网格：桌面端紧跟福利胶囊下方 */
.st-intro{margin-top:26px}
@media(min-width:900px){
  .hero .st-intro{grid-column:1;grid-row:3;align-self:start;margin-top:34px;display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .hero .tgline{grid-column:2;grid-row:3}
  .ticker{margin-top:40px}
}

/* ================= v17：单按钮 · 右侧 Banner 轮播 · 去背景 ================= */
.hero{padding:64px 0 0}
.stockbg,.hero-veil{display:none}
.cta-one{margin-top:22px}
.cta-btn.cta-m{display:flex}
.cta-btn.cta-d{display:none}
.cta-one .cta-btn{padding:17px 24px;font-size:17.5px}
/* 轮播 */
.bnr{position:relative;margin-top:18px;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden}
.bnr-track{display:flex;transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1)}
.bnr-slide{flex:0 0 100%;min-width:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;min-height:150px;padding:16px 18px 42px;position:relative;color:inherit}
.bs-main{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px}
.bs-big{font-family:'Inter Tight',sans-serif;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.04em;font-size:44px;line-height:1;flex:none;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.bs-big .u{font-size:20px;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin-left:1px}
.bs-t{font-size:16px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.35;margin-bottom:3px}
.bs-d{font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.6}
.bs-foot{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;padding:8px 20px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.bs-more{font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap}
.s-gold{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#FDEAC2 0%,#F0C888 44%,#D29C4C 100%);color:#3A2A0E}
.s-gold .bs-big,.s-gold .bs-t{color:#2A1D06}
.s-gold .bs-d{color:#6A5121}
.s-gold .bs-foot{background:rgba(42,29,6,.11);color:#5C4517}
.s-gold::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-30px;top:-60px;width:170px;height:170px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.6),transparent 68%);pointer-events:none}
.s-navy{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#182238 0%,#101728 58%,#0B1120 100%);color:#98A0AE;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
.s-navy .bs-big{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#A9C4FF,#4C7DFF);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
.s-navy .bs-t{color:#fff}
.s-navy .bs-d{color:#8A93A3}
.s-navy .bs-foot{background:rgba(61,123,255,.18);color:#9DBCFF}
.s-adv{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0F2A2A 0%,#0B1D24 55%,#0A1420 100%);color:#A8B4B8;border:1px solid rgba(52,211,153,.18)}
.bs-adv-t{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#5FD9B0;margin-bottom:8px}
.bs-adv ul{list-style:none;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px 12px}
.bs-adv li{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0;font-size:11px;color:#8FA3A8;line-height:1.35}
.bs-adv li b{color:#fff;font-size:13px;font-weight:700}
.bs-adv li b::before{content:"✓ ";color:#34D399}
.s-adv .bs-foot{background:rgba(52,211,153,.12);color:#7FE3C2}
.bnr-nav{position:absolute;bottom:5px;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;border:none;background:rgba(0,0,0,.35);color:#fff;font-size:18px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
.bnr-prev{right:46px}.bnr-next{right:12px}
@media(max-width:899px){.bs-more{display:none}.bs-foot{padding-right:86px}}
.bnr-dots{display:none;position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:44px;justify-content:center;gap:6px}
.bnr-dots button{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;border:none;background:rgba(255,255,255,.35);cursor:pointer;padding:0;transition:width .25s,background .25s}
.bnr-dots button.on{width:20px;border-radius:4px;background:#fff}
.s-gold ~ .bnr-dots button{background:rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
/* TG 卡加入按钮加大 */
.tg-go{display:inline-block;background:var(--blue);color:#fff;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;border-radius:100px;padding:9px 18px;margin-top:9px}
.tgline{margin-top:14px}
.st-intro{margin-top:24px}
.ticker{margin-top:16px}
@media(min-width:480px){.bs-big{font-size:50px}}
@media(min-width:900px){
  .hero{padding:110px 0 0}

      es.forEach(function(e){
        var past=!e.isIntersecting && e.boundingClientRect.top<0;
        sticky.classList.toggle('show',past);
        if(!dismissed) floatCard.classList.toggle('show',past);
        toTop.classList.toggle('show',past);
      });
    },{threshold:0}).observe(heroCta);
  }else{ sticky.classList.add('show'); }
  var onScroll=function(){ topbar.classList.toggle('solid',window.scrollY>60); };
  onScroll();
  window.addEventListener('scroll',onScroll,{passive:true});
  }catch(e){ var sc=document.getElementById('stickyCta'); if(sc) sc.classList.add('show'); }
})();
</script>




<style>
/* v20：Banner 三张海报图（1320×588，9:4），两端同尺寸，高度随宽度 */
.bnr-slide.pic{padding:0;min-height:0;display:block;aspect-ratio:1320/588;background:#050a18}
.bnr-slide.pic img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.bnr-dots{bottom:10px}
@media(max-width:899px){
  .bnr .bnr-nav{top:calc(50% - 14px);bottom:auto;background:rgba(0,0,0,.45)}
  .bnr-prev{left:10px;right:auto}
  .bnr-next{right:10px}
}
@media(min-width:900px){.bnr-slide.pic{min-height:0;padding:0}}
</style>

<style>
/* v23：移动端 Banner 放到标题下、按钮放到 Banner 下 */
@media(max-width:899px){
  .hero .wrap{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
  .hero .h-left{display:contents}
  .hero .h-left h1{order:1}
  .hero .bnr{order:2;margin-top:20px}
  .hero .cta-one{order:3;margin-top:18px}
  .hero .tgline{order:4}
  .hero .st-intro{order:5}
}
</style>

<style>
/* v23：移动端首屏顺序 Banner → 极速开户 → 明星股+行情 → 入群咨询；行情带移入 wrap 并出血 */
@media(max-width:899px){
  .hero .wrap{display:flex;flex-direction:column}

  .hero .h-left{order:2;margin-top:22px}
  .hero .st-intro{order:3;margin-top:26px}
  .hero .ticker{order:4;margin:14px -20px 0;width:calc(100% + 40px)}
  .hero .tgline{order:5;margin:20px 0 24px}
}

  .hero .ticker{grid-column:1/-1;grid-row:4;width:100vw;margin-left:calc(50% - 50vw);margin-top:40px}
}
</style>

<script>
/* 首屏 Banner 轮播：自动轮换，悬停/触摸暂停；PC 圆点，移动端左右键 */
(function(){
  var track=document.getElementById('bnrTrack'), bnr=document.getElementById('bnr'); if(!track||!bnr) return;
  var dots=document.querySelectorAll('#bnrDots button'), n=track.children.length, i=0, timer=null;
  var INTERVAL=3000; /* 轮换间隔（毫秒） */
  var reduce=window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  function go(k){ i=(k+n)%n; track.style.transform='translateX(-'+(i*100)+'%)'; dots.forEach(function(d,j){d.classList.toggle('on',j===i);}); }
  function start(){ if(reduce) return; stop(); timer=setInterval(function(){go(i+1);},INTERVAL); }
  function stop(){ if(timer){clearInterval(timer);timer=null;} }
  document.getElementById('bnrPrev').addEventListener('click',function(e){e.preventDefault();go(i-1);start();});
  document.getElementById('bnrNext').addEventListener('click',function(e){e.preventDefault();go(i+1);start();});
  dots.forEach(function(d,j){d.addEventListener('click',function(){go(j);start();});});
  bnr.addEventListener('mouseenter',stop); bnr.addEventListener('mouseleave',start);
  bnr.addEventListener('touchstart',stop,{passive:true}); bnr.addEventListener('touchend',start);
  var sx=null; bnr.addEventListener('touchstart',function(e){sx=e.touches[0].clientX;},{passive:true});
  bnr.addEventListener('touchend',function(e){ if(sx===null) return; var dx=e.changedTouches[0].clientX-sx; if(Math.abs(dx)>40) go(dx<0?i+1:i-1); sx=null; });
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',function(){document.hidden?stop():start();});
  go(0); start();
})();
</script>
<script src="/channel-analytics.js" defer></script>
</body>
</html>
